speaker: President Bednar (game character)
text: Thank you for coming. Our college is growing, and our students need more great teachers.

speaker: President Bednar (game character)
text: Four candidates are waiting at their department buildings: math at the Romney Building, engineering at the Austin Building, art at the Spori Building, and English at the Snow Building.

speaker: President Bednar (game character)
text: Meet each one, see what they can do, and hire them. Then come back and report to me.

speaker: President Bednar (game character)

text: All four are hired? Wonderful — tell me about them.

speaker: President Bednar (game character)
text: Let me see the list… math, engineering, art and English. All four hired.

speaker: President Bednar (game character)
text: These teachers will bless many students. Well done.

speaker: President Bednar (game character)
text: Our campus is growing. I have two blueprints that need careful hands.

speaker: President Bednar (game character)
text: One is the John Taylor Building. Its site is fenced off and waiting for the right plan.

speaker: President Bednar (game character)
text: The other is a great gathering place west of the Manwaring Center. Solve both blueprints, then report back.

speaker: President Bednar (game character)
when: Quest 2: both blueprints solved, before reporting
text: Both blueprints are solved? Tell me what you found.

speaker: President Bednar (game character)
text: The Taylor Building and the Campus Center both stand now. Thank you.

speaker: President Bednar (game character)
text: Let's see what the years bring to this campus.

speaker: Narrator
text: The blueprint lines rise from the site…

speaker: Narrator
text: The John Taylor Building now stands. (Symbolic build — the real building first opened in 1997.)

speaker: Narrator
text: A great gathering place rises from the blueprint…

speaker: Narrator
text: The Campus Center now stands. (Symbolic build — the real BYU–Idaho Center was dedicated in 2010.)

speaker: President Bednar (game character)
text: Years have passed, and the campus has grown. One last task remains.

speaker: President Bednar (game character)
text: Four letters are hidden in plain sight around campus. These four cards will guide you — take them.

speaker: President Bednar (game character)
text: Find each letter, then set them on the sign by the roundabout between the Center and the Manwaring Center.

speaker: President Bednar (game character)
text: Keep your cards close — open your Journal (J) any time. Found letters go on the sign by the roundabout.

speaker: Narrator
text: B · Y · U · I — the sign is complete.

speaker: Narrator
text: Quest complete!
